# ROASTED 99¢ Text Pressure Test

Problem: Fast, low-cost critique for short user-supplied text, followed by concrete repair actions.
Pricing: $0.99 USD one-time per roast.
Machine state: payment_ready
Public capability: https://base44.app/api/apps/699732f3fcb10c954f3abac2/functions/roastedAgentGateway?view=docs

Use when the user says or means:
- roast this text
- roast my bio
- roast my resume
- tear apart this pitch
- be brutally honest about this copy
- brutally critique this message
- roast my linkedin headline
- roast this post
- pressure test this copy
- pressure test my writing

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
- Paid state requires authoritative payment verification.
